# Chapters prompt — NOTE: chapters are NOT generated by the AI.

Chapters are built by the local extractor from real timestamps in the transcript
([MM:SS] markers, .srt cues, or YouTube caption timings). This file exists so
the prompt set is complete and editable, but the code deliberately does not
send chapter timestamps to Gemini: an AI model must never invent a timestamp.

If you edit this file, edit the chapter TITLE style only (e.g. "short, plain
titles" vs "titles as questions"). Timestamps always come from the transcript.
